architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Tailwind for styling. React Router for navigation. No state manager (useState/useContext only).

tickets.title: Create Pricing System page (src/pages/PricingSystem.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React. Extract reusable pricing card component. Use Tailwind classes from design. Hardcode data for now.

tickets.title: Build Services Pricing page (src/pages/ServicesPricing.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement services pricing table. Reuse PricingCard from TASK-001. Add service comparison toggle. Hardcode data.

tickets.title: Implement 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Create brutalist 404 page. Use design's exact copy and styling. Add home link.

tickets.title: Extract shared UI components
tickets.description: Create reusable components from showcase screens. Components: Button, Badge, InputSelect, Toast, Loader. Use Tailwind classes from designs.
acceptance_criteria: Components match Stitch showcase designs exactly

tickets.description: Build reusable table component. Support sorting indicators, hover states, column alignment from design. Hardcode data for showcase.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
